headline: Hegseth 'ready to go' after secret Israel visit
dek: Hegseth said Washington is prepared to take further military action against Iran if Trump orders it: 'We have inflicted devastating and unprecedented blows to their military capabilities. But if they are unwilling to abandon this path and the president wants us to go further, we are ready.'…
sources: Pete Hegseth remarks to reporters (via Al Jazeera, relayed 8am.media); Netanyahu video of Trump phone call (via Times Now); KAN on Zamir exclusion (via Yeni Safak)
fault_line: Deterrence or target list? Comment sections split: US naval power as deterrent vs Iranian missile-readiness claims; IG reel Oct 21 05:07 UTC drew 2.1K likes/210 comments; Iran Intl FB carrier post 3.9K/1.1K.

sections.what_happened: Hegseth said Washington is prepared to take further military action against Iran if Trump orders it: 'We have inflicted devastating and unprecedented blows to their military capabilities. But if they are unwilling to abandon this path and the president wants us to go further, we are ready.' Netanyahu told Trump 'we have a job to finish' on Iran in a video of their call. KAN reports IDF chief Zamir was excluded from the secret Netanyahu-Hegseth talks at Uvda airbase.
sections.what_verified: Hegseth quote: Al Jazeera early-Wednesday report relayed by 8am.media (published 04:50 UTC); consistent with Al Jazeera liveblog recap ('Hegseth said Washington was prepared to take further military action against Iran if Trump ordered it'). Netanyahu quote via Times Now (Oct 21) and Netanyahu Tel Hai speech ('must complete the elimination of the Iranian regime') via moraledge. Meeting at Uvda airbase confirmed by Reuters Oct 20.
sections.what_disputed: Pentagon has not publicly commented on the visit's content (Reuters Oct 20); Trump publicly declined to discuss Hegseth-Netanyahu conversation ('I can't do that now'). Both Trump and Netanyahu have said no strikes before US midterms (Nov 3) / Israel election (Oct 27). USNI News relief-framing caveat (Roosevelt relieving Washington) still tempers 'third carrier' framing.
sections.why_matters: Deal-or-attack: the midterm pivot date. Open with Hegseth's 'we are ready' + Netanyahu's 'job to finish' quotes (named attribution), then the USNI relief caveat, then the freeze dates (Oct 27 Israel election, Nov 3 midterms) as the tension frame. Note Zamir exclusion = Netanyahu not briefing his own army chief.
sections.context: Background: US-Iran escalation rhetoric — Hegseth 'ready to go' after secret Israel visit; Netanyahu 'we have a job to finish'; Zamir excluded from talks
